summary: Tested rebuilt Egypt PackageDetailPage (Maharaja-style). Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass validating new structure (stays/hotels/experiences/pricing/things_to_know/includes/highlights) across all 6 Egypt slugs + 404. Frontend: 40/40 critical UI checks pass — hero (title, EGYPT · 8 DAYS, ₹85,000, INQUIRE NOW), 4 sticky tabs (visually uppercase via CSS class), 7 Highlights bullets, sticky 'Speak to a specialist' sidebar with working inquiry form (submits successfully → Thank you state), Itinerary with Expand-All btn and timeline transport markers, first stay 'Cairo: Land of the Pyramids' (Day 1-3) expanded by default with Marriott Mena House hotel cards + experience cards, NO 'Add to Inquiry/Cart' buttons on hotel/experience cards (verified), second stay (Day 4-5) expands on click and reveals hotels/experiences, Pricing table with 7 monthly rows each having 'Inquire' button, FAQ accordion expands on click, 'What we include' shows 5 features, Other Egypt tours carousel shows 5 cards, bottom CTA shows ₹85,000 pp + Enquire button, navigation from /destination/Egypt → package detail works (6 View Itinerary links), honeymoon-on-the-nile loads correctly with ₹1,45,000. One real UI bug found: 'Other amazing Egypt tours' carousel uses pkg.hero_image (current package's image) for ALL other-tour cards instead of each tour's own hero — all cards display the same image.

ui_bugs.issue: All other-tour cards use the CURRENT package's hero_image as their thumbnail (line 467 of PackageDetailPage.js: ). Should use op.hero_image or op.image from the destination /detail packages list.

action_items: Fix 'Other amazing Egypt tours' carousel image: replace on line 467 of /app/frontend/src/components/PackageDetailPage.js with op.hero_image (or whichever image field /api/destinations/detail/{name} returns for each package). Currently every other-tour card shows the active package's hero image — visually misleading.

Optional: tab text content is 'At a Glance', 'Itinerary', 'Pricing', 'Things to Know' with CSS uppercase styling. This is fine for accessibility (screen readers prefer title case). If a strict text-content uppercase audit is desired, the source strings can be capitalised; currently they're visually correct.

rca_of_the_issue: Other-tours carousel image bug RCA: In /app/frontend/src/components/PackageDetailPage.js line 467, the carousel maps over otherPkgs (fetched from /api/destinations/detail/{name}) but renders where pkg is the CURRENT package, not the iteration variable 'op'. Since op contains the sibling package data (with op.title, op.duration etc.), it likely also has op.hero_image or op.image — using op.hero_image (or whichever image field that endpoint returns) will fix all 5 cards to show distinct images. Mitigation: change line 467 to for safe fallback.
